title: Amazon Isn’t Waiting for Black Friday. Here’s What’s Already on Sale
gist: A shopping roundup noting Amazon's Black Friday sale starts November 19, well before the traditional date, with early discounts already live on Sony, Apple, Amazon, Anker/Soundcore, Levoit, Eufy and De'Longhi products. The few business signals: Amazon is winding down its Fire tablet line in favor of new Alexa tablets, has raised prices on its own devices, and Soundcore is being rebranded as Anker.

insights.claim: Amazon's Black Friday deals start on November 19, well ahead of the traditional day after Thanksgiving, and the retailer has already discounted many items ahead of its own sale event.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Continued pull-forward of holiday promotions stretches the discount season and can blur Q4 sales timing for retailers and brands.
insights.locator: Amazon’s Black Friday deals start on November 19

insights.claim: Early pre-Black Friday discounts on Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones ($378, about 18% off) were matched by Walmart and Best Buy, showing competing retailers price-matching Amazon's early sale.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Price matching across major retailers limits Amazon's ability to win share purely on early promotions.

insights.claim: The arrival of new Alexa tablets has spelled the end of Amazon's budget Fire tablet series, with the Fire HD 10 discounted 53% to $73 in what may be a clearance; Amazon says it will support Fire tablets for another four years.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Amazon is repositioning its tablet hardware around Alexa, signaling a shift away from pure low-price devices.
insights.quote: The arrival of new Alexa tablets spelled the end of the Fire series, known for being budget-friendly.
insights.locator: Is it on sale or clearance?

insights.claim: Amazon has increased prices on its own products, and its Blink security cameras work only with Alexa; the Blink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+ is listed at $50 but on sale for $20 ahead of Black Friday.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Price increases on Amazon's own hardware suggest it is less willing to subsidize devices than in the past.
insights.quote: Like so many companies, Amazon has increased prices on its products.
insights.locator: You can expect Amazon’s own devices to go on sale

insights.claim: Soundcore, a value audio brand, is soon to be rebranded under its parent company's name, Anker.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Anker consolidating sub-brands under one name is a brand-strategy shift worth noting for consumer electronics watchers.
insights.locator: WIRED’s audio editor won’t stop praising Soundcore
